chapters.title: Counting with Animal Friends
chapters.description: Delightful early reading and discovery in Numbers

pages.title: 1 Majestic Lion King
bulletPoints: Number 1: One golden lion with a regal flowing mane resting under the acacia tree.
He looks across the savanna with wise, calm eyes as the sun rises.
Trace the number 1: Straight line down, and that is all!
One crown, one roar, and one brave heart.
pages.footerText: Page 1 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 2 Playful Dolphins
bulletPoints: Number 2: Two silvery dolphins leaping together over ocean waves.
They dive deep and splash high into the warm afternoon sea spray.
Trace the number 2: Half a heart and a line straight back!
Two fins, two smiles, and two best ocean buddies.
pages.footerText: Page 2 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 3 Gentle Pandas
bulletPoints: Number 3: Three black-and-white pandas sitting in the misty bamboo forest.
Crunch, crunch: They munch on fresh green bamboo shoots together.
Trace the number 3: Around a tree and around a tree, that makes a 3!
Three furry tummies, three happy faces.
pages.footerText: Page 3 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 4 Fluffy Bunnies
bulletPoints: Number 4: Four little cotton-tailed bunnies hopping through clover patches.
Twitch, twitch: Their pink noses sniff sweet purple blossoms.
Trace the number 4: Down and across, then down some more!
Four twitching ears, four hopping paws.
pages.footerText: Page 4 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 5 Chattering Squirrels
bulletPoints: Number 5: Five bushy-tailed squirrels scampering up the grandfather oak tree.
They hide acorns in secret mossy pockets under the roots.
Trace the number 5: Straight line down, round belly fat, give him a hat!
Five bushy tails, five sweet brown acorns.
pages.footerText: Page 5 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 6 Busy Honeybees
bulletPoints: Number 6: Six yellow-and-black striped honeybees buzzing around sunflower petals.
Buzzzz: Gathering golden pollen to make sweet honey in their hive.
Trace the number 6: Curve on down into a loop!
Six fluttering wings, six tiny legs.
pages.footerText: Page 6 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 7 Colorful Parrots
bulletPoints: Number 7: Seven rainbow parrots perched on tropical rainforest branches.
Bright scarlet, turquoise, emerald, and yellow feathers glistening in the sun.
Trace the number 7: Across the sky and down from heaven, that makes a 7!
Seven curved beaks whistling cheerful tunes.
pages.footerText: Page 7 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 8 Waddling Ducklings
bulletPoints: Number 8: Eight fluffy yellow ducklings paddling in a row behind mother duck.
Quack, quack: Splashing webbed feet in the cool lily pond.
Trace the number 8: Make an S and do not wait, climb back up to make an 8!
Eight webbed feet paddling together.
pages.footerText: Page 8 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 9 Shiny Goldfish
bulletPoints: Number 9: Nine sparkling goldfish gliding through crystal clear garden water.
Their shimmering orange scales catch the midday sunlight like floating lanterns.
Trace the number 9: A loop and a line make a 9 so fine!
Nine waving fins dancing in the water.
pages.footerText: Page 9 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 10 Playful Kittens
bulletPoints: Number 10: Ten curious kittens batting colorful balls of soft wool yarn.
Purr, purr: Rolling on their backs and pouncing with tiny paws.
Trace the number 10: Put 1 and 0 side by side for a complete decade!
Ten soft paws, ten twitching whiskers.
pages.footerText: Page 10 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 11 Chirping Sparrows
bulletPoints: Number 11: Eleven little brown sparrows greeting the sunrise from telephone wires.
Chirp, chirp: Singing a morning chorus to awaken the sleeping neighborhood.
Place value: 1 ten + 1 one = 11.
Eleven songs floating on the fresh morning breeze.
pages.footerText: Page 11 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 12 Galloping Zebras
bulletPoints: Number 12: Twelve zebras with striking black-and-white stripes racing across plains.
Their hooves drum a rhythmic beat on the dry grassy earth: clip-clop, clip-clop.
Twelve represents a full dozen! 10 + 2 = 12.
Twelve striped coats dazzling in the midday heat.
pages.footerText: Page 12 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 13 Curious Meerkats
bulletPoints: Number 13: Thirteen meerkats standing tall on tiptoes outside their desert burrow.
They scan the blue sky for eagles, standing on guard for their family.
Place value: 1 ten + 3 ones = 13.
Thirteen sharp eyes watching over the desert sand.
pages.footerText: Page 13 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 14 Spotted Ladybugs
bulletPoints: Number 14: Fourteen red ladybugs with polished black spots crawling on green leaves.
They protect rose bushes and gently fold their wings under shiny red shells.
Place value: 1 ten + 4 ones = 14.
Fourteen tiny garden guardians.
pages.footerText: Page 14 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 15 Woolly Sheep
bulletPoints: Number 15: Fifteen fluffy white sheep grazing peacefully on green mountain pastures.
Baa, baa: Chewing sweet meadow grasses under the watch of a loyal sheepdog.
Place value: 1 ten + 5 ones = 15.
Fifteen warm woolen coats soft as morning clouds.
pages.footerText: Page 15 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 16 Leaping Tree Frogs
bulletPoints: Number 16: Sixteen bright emerald tree frogs leaping between floating lily pads.
Ribbit, ribbit: Suction cup toes gripping wet leaves without slipping.
Place value: 1 ten + 6 ones = 16.
Sixteen green acrobats leaping over the pond.
pages.footerText: Page 16 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 17 Fluttering Butterflies
bulletPoints: Number 17: Seventeen monarch and swallowtail butterflies dancing in the flower garden.
Wings of gold, turquoise, violet, and orange sipping sweet flower nectar.
Place value: 1 ten + 7 ones = 17.
Seventeen living flower petals floating in the breeze.
pages.footerText: Page 17 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 18 Little Field Mice
bulletPoints: Number 18: Eighteen tiny field mice peeking curiously from golden bundles of hay.
Squeak, squeak: Gathering tiny grass seeds to store for winter in their cozy nest.
Place value: 1 ten + 8 ones = 18.
Eighteen pink noses twitching in the hay.
pages.footerText: Page 18 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 19 Glowing Fireflies
bulletPoints: Number 19: Nineteen warm fireflies blinking like floating fairy lights in twilight.
Flash, glow: Illuminating the velvet dusk over the sleeping meadow grass.
Place value: 1 ten + 9 ones = 19.
Nineteen magical lanterns shining in the dark.
pages.footerText: Page 19 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends

pages.title: 20 Animal Friends Celebration!
bulletPoints: Number 20: Twenty animal friends gather in the meadow for a grand counting party!
Lions, pandas, dolphins, ducklings, and fireflies celebrate together.
Two full tens: 10 + 10 = 20!
You are a champion counter: From 1 to 20, you know every single number by heart!
pages.footerText: Page 20 of 20 · Counting with Animal Friends
